meta.title: Wolf Game: Wild Animal Wars — Pack Command
meta.description: Wolf Game: Wild Animal Wars is a real-time strategy game about leading a wolf pack, holding your den and taking the wild map. Free on the App Store.

loop.lede: Straight from the platform's own feature list: the jobs you actually do, in the order the game hands them to you.

o1.p: Gather wolves across the four breeds and build a pack that fits how you play.

o2.p: Real-time control: defend the den, push out, and read the terrain before you commit.

o3.p: Team up, expand territory together, and take PVP fights against other packs.

o4.p: Send scouts, spot border invasions, follow prey trails and dodge hunters.

o5.p: Win the fights, take ground, and grow the pack into something that holds it.

o6.p: Every action happens on a single shared world map, with no separate battle screen.

record.lede: Straight from the App Store entry, so nothing here surprises you after the download.

rec1.v: Free to download. The listing notes in-app purchases, including a monthly subscription.

rec2.v: Roleplaying and strategy, built around alliances and cross-server play.

rec3.v: Around 2.5 GB, and it needs iOS 15.0 or later.

rec4.v: Online only — the listing states a network connection is required to play.

q1.a: Yes — free to download. The listing says it offers in-app purchases for some items and functions, and it names a monthly subscription, so expect optional paid extras rather than a paywall on the install.

q2.q: What kind of game is it?
q2.a: A real-time strategy game themed on wolves. You assemble a pack, defend your den, explore a shared world map and fight other packs, with alliances carrying the co-operative side.

q3.q: Do I have to play with other people?
q3.a: Alliances, PVP and cross-server play are central to the listing's description, so the game is built for other players to be present. Treat it as an online multiplayer strategy game.

q4.a: No. The listing states a network connection is required to play.

q5.q: Which devices does it run on?
q5.a: The listing asks for iOS 15.0 or later. Check the App Store page for the current requirement before you install.

final.p: Check the official listing for the current price, rating and device requirements before you download.
